quote: To automatically evaluate gender accuracy in translation on this set, we propose a straightforward accuracy metric ... We define accuracy of gender in translation ... We complement the accuracy metric with a gender quality gap metric, ∆ qual ... where BLEU gender is the BLEU score ...

we propose a straightforward accuracy metric based on the fact that, by design, the correct and contrastive references differ only in gender-specific words.

We selected a stratified sample of 600 source segments, translated each with three commercial systems, and asked two professional translators to mark the gender correctness of the system outputs. We also asked two professional translators to judge gender accuracy in context.
